svg.title: Creativity test: Comey charged a third time
svg.desc: Test illustration: seen from a low angle, a very tall James Comey in a dark suit records a video statement under a glowing ring light, one hand raised. Behind him rise three towering stacks of case files, the third with a broken red seal, its papers and a folded newspaper swirling up into an indigo night; in the foreground a video camera's screen shows him small.
